insights: Sell-through averaged 85.9% but ranged from 73% to 100%. 8 soft games hold 32% of all unsold seats, and 100% of them are weekday games.
16.7% of tickets sold were never scanned. No-shows run 18.6% on weekdays against 13.9% on weekends.
6,471 repeat buyers went quiet in the final 60 days. They average $860 per fan, more than active repeat attendees ($684).
5,799 non members bought five or more separate games at single game prices, averaging 2.6 seats at $118 per seat.
Email, SMS, and push returned 12.9x on cost against 0.7x for paid media. Upsell was the best campaign type at 15.0x ROI.

recommendations.action: Retarget at-risk and first-time buyers with post-game offers
recommendations.detail: Win-back offers to 6,471 at-risk fans, highest spenders first, and a second game offer within 14 days for 5,706 first-time buyers.
recommendations.sizing: Recovering 15% of at-risk value is worth about $834,876. A repeat attendee averages $684 against $280 for a first-time buyer.

recommendations.action: Bundle weekday games to lift sell-through
recommendations.detail: Weeknight bundles, group offers, and theme nights on the 8 games with the weakest demand.
recommendations.sizing: Selling 25% of 31,155 unsold seats at a 20% discount is worth about $589,278.

recommendations.action: Upsell high-frequency fans into plans and premium products
recommendations.detail: Mini plan and premium seating offers to 5,799 non members who already buy five or more games.
recommendations.sizing: 10% take-up adding 3 games each is worth about $536,092.

recommendations.action: Focus campaigns on high-conversion segments and owned channels
recommendations.detail: Prioritize the High-Value Fan segment, which converts at 23.4%, and move part of the $88,000 paid media budget into email, SMS, and push.
recommendations.sizing: Owned channels returned 12.9x against 0.7x for paid media. Best campaign: App Flash Sale at 21.7x.

recommendations.action: Strengthen sponsor activations tied to high-engagement environments
recommendations.detail: Add interactive activations for Saguaro Auto Group and Valley Sun Energy, the two partners with the lowest engagement. Both rely on signage and displays only.
recommendations.sizing: Fan Zone Sampling engages 11.1% of the fans it reaches against 0.04% for Courtside LED Signage.

recommendations.action: Monitor sold versus scanned gaps to reduce no-shows
recommendations.detail: Weekly sold versus scanned report by game, plus ticket exchange and outreach for 1,192 season ticket accounts using under 75% of their tickets.
recommendations.sizing: Those accounts hold $13.87M of ticket revenue. Weekday no-shows run 18.6% against 13.9% on weekends.
